- Review and approve pending timecards in [SYSTEM]
- Resolve missing punches and verify overtime
- Confirm PTO entries are correct

If you have exceptions, reply with: Employee, Hours/Amount, Reason, Approval. Thank you!

Reminder: Please submit and correct your timecard for [START–END] by [TIME] today. If you need help, ping your manager or People Ops. Late entries may delay pay.

+- Employee master deltas (columns): EmployeeID, Name, Department, ChangeType(NewHire/Term/Rate/Title/Location/Bank/Tax), EffectiveDate, Details, ApprovedBy
+- Variable comp (columns): EmployeeID, Name, CompType(Bonus/Commission/SPIF), Amount, Currency, Period, CostCenter, ApprovedBy
+- Exceptions (columns): EmployeeID, Name, ExceptionType(Overtime/Retro/PTO/ManualAdj), Hours/Amount, Reason, ApprovedBy
+- Timecard status (columns): EmployeeID, Name, Manager, Status(Approved/Pending/Missing), Hours, Notes
+- Variance report (columns): EmployeeID, Name, Dept, PriorGross, CurrentGross, VarianceAmt, VariancePct, Reason
+
+Operational Steps (detailed)
+1) HRIS audit
+   - Pull changes effective within this pay period and through cut‑off
+   - Reconcile against change log from HR/People Ops
+2) T&A reconciliation
+   - Export timecard status; filter pending/unapproved
+   - Nudge managers with targeted comms; escalate overdue items
+3) Variable comp collection
+   - Send request to Department Heads; require approvals and GL/cost center tagging
+4) Pre‑payroll variance check
+   - Join prior vs current gross; flag >±10% variance or >$500 threshold
+5) Final approvals and funding
+   - Summarize exceptions and obtain sign‑off from HRBP + Finance
+   - Confirm bank file approver availability and backup approver
+
+Ready‑to‑Send Communications (edit names/dates before sending)
+A) Managers — Timecard Approval Reminder (Email)
+Subject: Action required today: Approve your team’s timecards by [TIME]
+
+Hi Managers,
+Please approve your team’s timecards for the period [START–END] by [TIME] today so payroll can process on schedule.
+
+What to do now
+- Review and approve pending timecards in [SYSTEM]
+- Resolve missing punches and verify overtime
+- Confirm PTO entries are correct
+
+If you have exceptions, reply with: Employee, Hours/Amount, Reason, Approval. Thank you!
+
+B) Employees — Fix Missing Time (Slack/Teams)
+Reminder: Please submit and correct your timecard for [START–END] by [TIME] today. If you need help, ping your manager or People Ops. Late entries may delay pay.
+
+C) Department Heads — Variable Comp Request (Email)
+Subject: Variable comp for this payroll — due [TIME]
+
+Hi all,
+Please submit approved variable comp for this cycle using the attached template (EmployeeID, Amount, Type, Cost Center, ApprovedBy) by [TIME]. If none, please confirm “No variable comp.”
+
+D) HR/People Ops — HRIS Change Log Confirmation (Email)
+Subject: HRIS changes for this payroll — confirmation needed
+
+Hi People Ops,
+Please share the change log (new hires, terms, rate/title/location/bank/tax changes) effective through cut‑off, or confirm no changes.
+
+E) Finance/Payroll — Status Update (Email)
+Subject: Pre‑payroll status — awaiting POC/cut‑off confirmation
+
+Hi Finance/Payroll,
+I attempted to reach Kwame (Finance POC) but received an unavailable response. I’m proceeding with the standard pre‑payroll sweep and holding comms drafts ready. Please confirm: (1) payroll input cut‑off, (2) bank file deadline, (3) systems in scope, and (4) approvers. I’ll circulate an exceptions and variance summary once inputs are compiled.
+
+Escalation Path
+1) If POC is unavailable in 30 minutes, request alternate POC from Finance leadership and People Ops lead.
+2) If timecards remain unapproved by T‑2 hours, escalate to department leadership with list of impacted employees.
+3) If bank file approver is unavailable, trigger backup approver.
+
+Contingencies
+- Missed timecards: process based on scheduled/average hours with clear notation; true‑up next cycle
+- Late variable comp: exclude from this run; schedule off‑cycle or include next payroll with approvals
+- Funding risk: reduce to essentials and/or split run if allowed by vendor
+
+Deliverables After Execution
+- Exceptions log (CSV/Sheet)
+- Variable comp file (CSV/Sheet)
+- Timecard status report
+- Variance summary and rationale
+- Final approvals archive
+
+Paste‑Ready Slack Messages
+- Managers channel: “Urgent: Please approve all pending timecards for [START–END] by [TIME] today. Instructions: [link]. Reply ‘done’ when complete.”
+- Company channel (if needed): “Friendly reminder to submit timecards by [TIME] for on‑time payroll. Thank you!”
+
+Notes
+- Replace placeholders [TIME], [START–END], [SYSTEM] and add links to instructions where applicable.
+- Maintain an audit trail of all approvals in one folder for this cycle.
+
